Here is a line-by-line transcription of the Latin marriage register entries shown in **image_84d0ea.png**.

The entries follow a standard format: the day of the month (*Die...*), the names of the groom and bride in the accusative case (*...et...*), the witnesses (*Coram...* meaning "in the presence of"), and the officiating priest (*Joannes Quinlan CC* or *or* for Catholic Curate).
